title: advising at the precipice of change
content:
the deep work of guiding transformations

I made this visual recently to capture how I’ve been refining and conceptualizing my advising sessions — as a deep inner inquiry process, and collaborative container for transformation.

how I guided myself

I realized that my advising sessions are a potent distillation of an internal process that I’ve been doing to myself, everyday, my entire creative life — in order to navigate tremendous change, and to imagine new possibilities.

my job, you could say, is in the reimagining of possibilities.

I disregarded all the ways you were “supposed” to do anything — be a “real” artist, do online marketing, have a business, be on social media, build a brochure website that sells, make money, be recognized, successful, stable. none of that worked for me — all of that felt wrong, exhausting, depleting, fake.

I didn’t want to compromise. I wanted to feel true to myself. I wanted to break everything down and reimagine it from the ground up to find what truly felt sustainable for me. I ventured into the void, and made infinite pathways for myself that didn’t exist before. it was hard as hell for a very long time. then it became effortless.

guidance at the threshold

it makes sense, then, that my clients usually reach out to me when they’re on the precipice of significant change — quitting jobs, moving states or countries, leaving social media, beginning new creative and business ventures. they are ready to take a leap into the void and trust that they will be supported, will be caught in a web of safety — by life, and by themselves — and taken to a new reality.

they’re asking, “is this possible??? can I really do this? what should I do!?”

and I say, “why wouldn’t it be possible? what beliefs are creating resistance for you? how do you recognize when you’re on the right path?”

we look at the the hard things — the extra baggage that’s burdening their journey, the sticky beliefs and resistance that’s blocking the flow.

we plot a roadmap together.

we explore practices, processes, milestones.

even more important than any plans, I think, is navigational clarity.

  • how do you know when you’re on the right path — for you, and your vision?

  • how do you calibrate to your true north?

  • how do you know when to stop and rest or reset, and when to keep going?

  • how do you navigate the day-to-day, with self-compassion and sensitivity?

advising process

beginning

I start each advising process by asking clients to email me and tell me about themselves and what they hope to work on together. then, after we do scheduling and payment logistics, I’ll create a Notion advising dashboard for them — a collaborative guidance container — like a magical liminal pool that we enter in, together, where the deep work begins.

excavation (1+ weeks)

there, I’ll write a list of excavation questions for them to explore slowly — over the next week (minimum) or several weeks, at their own pace.

I write custom questions for each client, based on what they’ve shared with me in their introduction email. these questions are crucial — the process of answering them is like taking an elixir potion, drawing out all of the dreams, visions, strengths, fears, resistances, blockages, reoccuring patterns. so much deep work happens here already, in just answering these questions in a safe, contained space.


intensive session (2 hours)

an intensive session is long — 2 hours — because I’d rather do deep work, than offer quick fixes that may or may not last. to do that, I want to understand the holistic tangled web of a client’s creative/business journey — what lead them here to this moment of transition — and where they want to go next, what’s creating friction and stuckness. then we chart a roadmap, together. I use a visual brainmapping tool (figma jam), and also record our conversation for distillation notes.


integration & navigational tools (a few days later)

after our session, I’ll distill our work together into different forms —

  • a video recording of our call

  • an audio recording

  • visual notes we took together

  • a wayfinding guide text document — with notes on your next steps, further questions to explore, recommendations for daily practices, your resistance patterns, and guiding compass to help you move forward.

the intention is to give my clients a thorough and detailed map of everything — for their spiraling voyage onwards.

*

I’m currently imagining what future offerings might be next, after advising intensives. currently, I do 90 minute returning sessions for previous advising clients.

I do find myself craving the satisfaction of witnessing and supporting a client over a longer cycle of time, so I’m dreaming up of an asynchronous monthly offering, perhaps through the guidance portal + weekly voice message responses.

I’ll share more on this soon.
